topic: Myth: mining rewards mean a fixed income
hook: Mining rewards arrive in bitcoin. Your electricity bill doesn't.

scenes.narration: People assume mining rewards are a steady, fixed income.
Rewards are paid in BTC, but electricity and hosting costs are paid in fiat.
So profitability moves with the bitcoin price, and returns are never certain.
Electricity is typically a miner's largest ongoing cost, so check it before anything else.

cta: Would you have checked the costs first? Tell me below, and see the link on my channel page.
title: Myth: Bitcoin Mining Rewards Are Steady Income
description_body: Mining rewards are paid in BTC while costs are paid in fiat, so results move with the bitcoin price and are never certain.
